name: Combat Balladeer
body:
You fought as an elite combat balladeer in the Century War and were allowed to retain your instrument weapon after your service.

Prerequisite(s): Human, Infused, or Phalanx. You may only select this feat at 1st level.

Benefit(s): You gain an instrument weapon, a special combination of masterwork weapon and masterwork musical instrument that is an identifier of your military service to the Hierarchy.

Additionally, you gain a +1 bonus on Diplomacy checks made against members of the Protectorate.
